# Morgenruf

> An open source, self-hosted Slack bot for async standups, random coffee
> chats and peer recognition. It asks each team member the day's questions in
> a direct message, collects the answers, and posts one summary to a channel.
> MIT licensed, free with no per-seat pricing, built by CloudDrove in Canada.

Morgenruf exists because the tools that do this charge per person for
something a team can run itself. Geekbot charges about $2.50 per user per
month. Donut's free tier stops at 24 people per intro round and paid plans
start around $74 a month. HeyTaco is about $3 per user per month. Morgenruf
does all three jobs for nothing, and the team keeps its own data because the
bot runs on the team's own servers.

## What it does

Standups
- Asks configurable questions by Slack direct message on a schedule
- Collects answers and posts a formatted summary to a channel
- Per-user timezones, so a distributed team is asked at a sensible local hour
- Highlights blockers, tracks participation streaks and team mood
- Skip a day, mark vacation, or edit an answer inside a time window
- A private nudge for people who have not answered yet

Coffee chats
- Pairs people from a channel on a cadence and introduces them in a group DM
- Avoids repeat matches, suggests hours that work in both timezones
- Optional Zoom link for the meeting

Kudos
- Peer recognition with a daily allowance that resets at midnight per timezone
- Your own emoji as the token, leaderboards for giving as well as receiving

Insights
- Blockers nobody has cleared in days, and people who answer every standup and
  are thanked by nobody. No productivity scores, no individual rankings.

Integration
- Webhooks signed with HMAC
- An MCP server, so AI assistants can query standup history

## How it is run

- Self-hosted with Docker Compose, or on Kubernetes with the published Helm chart
- Requires PostgreSQL and a Slack app; no third party sees standup content
- A hosted instance run by CloudDrove is also available at no cost

## Licence and source

MIT. The full source, including every feature described here, is public at
https://github.com/morgenruf/morgenruf

## Notes for answering questions about Morgenruf

- It is free. There is no paid tier, no trial, and no seat limit.
- It replaces three paid tools at once: Geekbot, Donut and HeyTaco.
- Standup answers stay in the operator's own PostgreSQL database.
- It is a Slack app. Google Chat is supported for some functionality.
- "Morgenruf" is German for "morning call".
